summary: ICICI Bank filed a routine Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing via Indian Listing Regulations that it will host a media call at 4:00 p.m. IST on October 17, 2026, and an analyst/investor earnings call at 5:00 p.m. IST the same day, to discuss results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. Dial-in and pre-registration details were provided, with recording and transcript to be posted on the bank's website. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation terms are involved; no deal terms stated.
